title: 347 名得深字大力346 驭气者之间的战斗
content_zh:
3名得深，字大力
“你认识我？”
察觉到来人脸上神色的变化，曹笔眼睛微眯，沉声开口。
“爹，他身上没有味道。”
刀疤女在对方愣神的瞬间，鼻子用力嗅了嗅，用尽最后一丝力气告知曹笔。
随即闭上眼睛，脑袋直接耷拉在曹笔背上，再次沉沉睡去。
曹笔闻言，顿感意外，原本的杀意骤然收敛，心中不由得疑惑起来。
对方身上没有味道，那就说明对方不是什么罪大恶极之人。
顶多是不好不坏，中间地带。
就算卞参将落在这种人手中，大概率是没生命危险的，这意味着对方今夜的行动，不为杀戮，意在绑架！
“你杀了万俟家的万俟三根，还杀了神策营的人，今夜拦路，还想杀了我不成？”
面具人虽然是第一次见曹笔，但他来之前，研究过曹笔的画像与之前的事迹。
知道对方是一个高手，但究竟有多高，他不清楚。
“我只是想请阁下喝杯茶，阁下敌意何故这般大？”
曹笔突然微微一笑，眼神意味莫名。
面具人没有说话，默默地打量着曹笔。
数息后。
见曹笔似乎并未察觉到自己的感知，当即暗道：“此人连第二感都没开，就算有点实力，恐怕也不会太强。
那些传信的人，多半是以讹传讹，夸大其词。”
一念及此，他便稳下心来，居高临下地看着曹笔，冷声开口质问道：“你是谁，为何要杀万俟三根和神策营的人？”

“我姓曹，名得深，字大力，他们都叫我大力曹。
阁下若是觉得大力过于冒犯，也可以叫我小力曹。”
曹笔一本正经地介绍自己，并给自己临时取了个外号。
顿了顿，进一步解释道：“我杀万俟三根，是因为他当众辱我。
我杀神策营的人，是因为神策营的人要先杀我。”
“哼！你少要诓人，别以为我听不出你言外之意，世间怎会有如此不要脸的名字和外号？”
面具人似乎很生气，说话的时候，都带着一股咬牙切齿的味道。
曹笔乐了，故作不解反问道：“言外之意，我有甚言外之意？”
面具人一愣，见对方还在装，咬了咬后槽牙道：“你说你姓曹，名得深，那我问你，你曹什么曹得深？
还字大力，别人叫你大力曹，那人怕不是某个窑姐儿吧？”
“咳咳~”
曹笔没想到对方竟然这么聪明，一下就戳穿了自己的恶趣味，当即进行解释：“我不是说了吗，你若是觉得冒犯，也可以叫我小力曹。”
content_en:
3. The name is deep and the word is Dali.
"You know me?"
Noticing the change in the expression on the visitor's face, Cao Bi narrowed his eyes slightly and spoke in a deep voice.
"Dad, he doesn't smell like anything."
When the other party was stunned, Scar Girl sniffed hard and used her last bit of strength to tell Cao Bi.
Then he closed his eyes, dropped his head directly on Cao Bi's back, and fell asleep again.
When Cao Bi heard this, he was suddenly surprised. His original murderous intention suddenly restrained, and he couldn't help but feel doubtful in his heart.
If the other party has no smell, it means that the other party is not a heinous person.
At best, it's neither good nor bad, somewhere in the middle.
Even if Bian Shen falls into the hands of such a person, there is a high probability that his life will not be in danger. This means that the other party's actions tonight are not for killing, but for kidnapping!
"You killed Wan Qi Sangen of the Wan Qi family, and also killed people from the Shence Camp. Are you trying to kill me tonight when you block the road?"
Although it was the first time for the masked man to see Cao Bi, he had studied Cao Bi's portrait and previous deeds before coming.
He knew that the other party was a master, but he didn't know how high he was.
"I just want to treat you to a cup of tea. Why are you so hostile?"
Cao Bi suddenly smiled slightly, his eyes meaning incomprehensible.
The masked man said nothing and looked at Cao Bi silently.
After counting the interest.
Seeing that Cao Bi didn't seem to be aware of his own perception, he immediately said to himself: "This person doesn't even have a second sense. Even if he has some strength, I'm afraid he won't be too strong.
Most of those who conveyed the message were spreading lies and exaggerating. "
As soon as he thought of this, he calmed down, looked at Cao Bi condescendingly, and asked in a cold voice: "Who are you, and why do you want to kill Wanqi Sangen and the people from Shence Camp?"
"My surname is Cao, my name is Shen, my courtesy name is Dali, so they all call me Dali Cao.
If you feel that Dali is too offensive, you can also call me Xiaoli Cao. "
Cao Bi introduced himself seriously and gave himself a temporary nickname.
After a pause, he further explained: "I killed Wanqisangen because he humiliated me in public.
I killed the people from Shence Camp because the people from Shence Camp wanted to kill me first. "
"Hmph! Don't try to trick me. Don't think that I can't understand what you mean. How can there be such shameless names and nicknames in the world?"
The masked man seemed very angry, and when he spoke, there was a smell of gnashing of teeth.
Cao Bi was amused, and pretended to be confused and asked: "What do I mean behind the words?"
The masked man was stunned for a moment, seeing that the other party was still pretending, he gritted his teeth and said: "You said your surname is Cao, and your name is famous, so let me ask you, what is Cao that makes you so famous?
Your nickname is Dali, and others call you Dali Cao. Is that person probably not some kiln girl? "
"Ahem~"
Cao Bi didn't expect that the other party was so smart. He immediately exposed his bad intentions and immediately explained: "Didn't I say, if you feel offended, you can call me Xiao Li Cao."
